DRDO tests hack-free quantum communication for military data

The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully tested a hack-free quantum communication system designed to protect sensitive military data. The test involved a Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) platform deployed in a live network, marking an advancement in India's quantum-secure defence communications.
